item.title: Enraging the Culture w/ Douglas Wilson & Jonathan Bock [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description:
Originally aired on March 19, 2018. 

First, we interviewed Jonathan Bock, President of Grace Hill Media and co-author of The Way Back (number one on Amazon in March). In The Way Back, media and marketing experts Phil Cooke and Jonathan Bock take a hard look at Christians today and reveal that we, as a salesforce, have lost our faith in our product. Where’s the passion, the excitement, and the commitment that two thousand years ago made such improbable and staggering growth possible?

 

We were also joined by Pastor Doug Wilson to discuss why the church should be enraging the culture! You should join Pastor Wilson this April 13th and 14th at the Grace Agenda conference in Moscow, Idaho. It is free, so you have no excuses. 

 

In CrossPolitic news, we cover a college student who was kicked out of class for arguing that there are only two genders, and a Rocklin High School teacher who is on paid administrative leave for her views about the national school walk out. Our theme is why logic doesn't work with public education.

item.title: America’s Past Shame | Why the Civil War Still Matters w/ Thomas DiLorenz (FlashBack Friday) [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Originally aired on January 15, 2018. Slavery is shameful, abortion is atrocious. item.title: Unmasking the Narrative: A Conversation w/ Dr. Ryan Cole [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: In this eye-opening episode of CrossPolitic, we sit down with Dr. Ryan Cole, a leading pathologist and vocal critic of mainstream medical narratives. Dr. Cole shares his insights on the COVID-19 pandemic, health policy, and the challenges of navigating truth in a polarized world. This conversation cuts through the noise to explore the science, data, and broader implications for health freedom. Don't miss this compelling discussion.
